"In the name of the Timekeeper,
  I shall guide you to the past.
  {var:1}, step forward.

"if you want me to, I will again
  entrust my life to you. I'll be the
  Luminary's shield as many times as it takes!

  tacky. A farewell should be light.

  We'll meet again in the past!

"You'll be fine, {var:1}.
  I'm sure you'll overcome any hardship.

"But if it doesn't work out...
  rely on us once more.

"Now, {var:1}...
  let your grandfather see your face.

"After all, you're my

  irreplaceable. I will never forget them...
"Will you find me again?

"The time has come.
  Now, to times long past...!
